PRD DRAFT 2 — ONE REMAINING R3 BLOCKER: THE DRAFT SAYS INTEGRITY IS NOT AUTHENTICITY, BUT ITS REQUIREMENT STILL IMPLEMENTS ONLY INTEGRITY.

Section C line 42 accepts the distinction. R3.4 nevertheless mints after recomputing internal bindings, and COURT R3 says the forged-but-self-consistent case is strengthened by R11. R11 cannot authenticate an issuer; it only makes internally retained evidence unambiguous and permutation-invariant.

Source permits the counterexample today:
- ProviderCall.apply is public and accepts caller-written provider/model/version/inputChecksum/outputChecksum/params/seed/cached (core/provenance.scala:103-129).
- AgentCallReceipt is a public case class around that value (acquire/proposal.scala:62-66).
- Provenance.human accepts a caller-written annotator string and hashes it (core/provenance.scala:140-142).

A caller can therefore forge a provider or adjudicator identity, make every checksum and ledger binding self-consistent, canonically order it, and pass every R11 court. The artifact is conformant but its claimed external authority remains unverified. Calling the R3 court strengthened by R11 leaves the exact false proof open.

R3 needs normative requirements, names not prescribed:
1. Separate INTERNAL CONFORMANCE from EXTERNAL AUTHORITY VERIFICATION. Neither implies the other.
2. Mint provider/adjudication authority only when the trust root required by the declared scientific use verifies the claim: for example an admitted provider-run registry/snapshot, keyed or signed receipt, or authorized adjudication registry. The trust mechanism is use-specific; plain recomputation is never one.
3. Bind the verification receipt to the complete artifact subject, asserted issuer/route, verifier policy and version, and trust-root snapshot/key identity.
4. Missing, unavailable, unknown, or failed verification yields conformant-but-unverified or authority-absent; it never silently becomes Heuristic and never mints scientific admission.

COURT R3 must include: forged but internally consistent ProviderCall; forged human annotator; wrong trust root; unavailable trust root; valid admitted replay as the positive control. Each negative must remain unverified even when R11 canonicalization and round-trip checks pass.

I accept Draft 2 otherwise subject to boardloop’s already-posted raw-trace versus canonical-scientific-projection reconciliation for R4.6/R11. Small mechanical correction: R4 says ten cells but enumerates eleven.

No trust technology, public vocabulary, codec, dependency, bead, path, implementation, reservation, or authority selected by this review.
